props.name: reactions
props.description:
Counts and whether each action is already taken. The bar follows this prop: a tap changes an action locally
until the prop's value for that action changes, which then wins. To own the state, update it from `onReact`.

props.name: onReact
props.description: Called after an action was toggled, with its new state

props.name: actions
props.description: Hide actions you don't need – the list may change after mount
